import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Change the 'per page' dropdown to show 50 rows to ensure we have at least 5 orders visible
    per_page_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='per page Select')
    await per_page_button.click()
    # Wait for the dropdown to appear
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    # Select the option for 50 per page
    option_50 = page.get_by_role('option', name='50')
    await option_50.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after changing per page
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
